papers.title: GeoWorldAD: Geometry World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Songyan Zhang, Jinyuan Tian, Hanbing Li et al.
papers.summary: 几何世界动作模型，将轨迹规划锚定在自车对齐的3D空间中，通过潜在未来几何token预测短时场景演化。渐进式多尺度几何聚合+轨迹迭代优化，NAVSIM v1/v2 SOTA

papers.title: What Do They See? Interpreting Complex Road Scenarios Through the Eyes of Vision-Language-Action Models for Safe and Trustworthy Autonomous Vehicle Learning
papers.authors: Kalpana Panda, Wesley Maia, Vinti Agarwal, Ross Greer
papers.summary: 提出CVAA框架，通过生成式修复去除图像中单个物体，评估对VLA模型规划行为的因果影响。在Alpamayo 1轨迹预测器+210个nuScenes场景上验证，构建Counter-nuScenes数据集

papers.title: VLN-AVP: Zero-Shot Vision-Language Navigation with Hybrid Long-Short-Term Memory for Autonomous Valet Parking
papers.authors: Yijian Li, Xiangru Mu, Changze Li et al.
papers.summary: 零样本VLN自动代客泊车框架，融合BEV空间感知+VLM通用智能，无需预建地图。短时记忆跟踪语义线索+长时拓扑记忆稳定策略学习。构建首个地下车库VLN-AVP数据集(10场景1000+episode)

papers.title: PhyAgentOS: A Self-Evolving Operating System for Embodied Agents with Decoupled Cognitive Planning and Physical Execution
papers.authors: Yang Liu, Weixing Chen, Xinshuai Song et al.
papers.summary: 具身智能体OS运行时基座，解耦认知规划与物理执行。Session-Centered Runtime + State-as-a-File协议，支持VLA/世界模型/agentic planner统一调度与验证。19+模拟和实体embodiment验证
